captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a heavy-duty parametric L-bracket designed for structural reinforcement or mounting. It consists of a horizontal base plate and a vertical wall of equal width, reinforced by two parallel triangular gussets (bracers) along the outer edges. Each of the two mounting faces features a single, centralized stadium-shaped slot (rounded slot) to allow for adjustable screw positioning.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric L-bracket in OpenSCAD with adjustable vertical and horizontal side lengths, wall thickness, and internal width. Ensure it includes two outer triangular reinforcing gussets and a centralized, stadium-shaped mounting slot on each face.
captions.factory: The design uses a custom 'stadium3d' module, which constructs a 3D slot using a central cube unioned with two cylinders at either end. The main bracket body is built from two perpendicular plates (using cube and difference) to subtract the slot shapes. Finally, two triangular bracers are created using 2D polygons extruded with linear_extrude and positioned on the outer edges to reinforce the corner joint.
